description: DESTRUCTIVE: revert a VPS to a snapshot. Everything written after that snapshot — files, databases, mail, new users — is LOST, and the VPS restarts. Never call it on your own initiative: name the snapshot and its date to the customer, confirm they accept losing everything since then, and prefer taking a fresh snapshot first so the current state is still recoverable. Requires the "manage" scope. If confirm_token is absent from this connection's input schema, use a connection that exposes it or a supported customer-portal flow. A quote or confirmation request is not completion. IRREVERSIBLE — takes two calls: the first returns a confirm_token and changes nothing, the second repeats the same arguments plus confirm_token and executes.

name.description: Snapshot name to roll back to, exactly as listed by impreza_vps_list_snapshots.

name: impreza_vps_rollback_snapshot
title: Roll VPS back to snapshot
